certificate.proof: With nonnegative J and B=0, any invalid Sudoku board has at least one equal-digit true peer pair, hence E>=min_true_peer_J. If tau+tol<that minimum, exact E<=tau+tol implies Sudoku validity. Extra nonnegative edges may reject valid boards but cannot invalidate this implication.
certificate.numerical_limit: This proves an exact-energy implication for the saved coefficients, not a worst-case floating-point error bound for incremental Triton energies. The runtime certificate can differ under numerical drift; saved returned boards are independently validated separately.
